_comment: Advice/emission registry for the ten LIVEPLAN signals. Signal names mirror the legacy rule IDs (dwell_*, oscillation, repeated_view, thought_oscillation, plan_compliance_*). Messages are the default_rules.json baselines. 'enabled:false' signals evaluate in shadow mode for differential logging but are never surfaced to the agent. The plan-compliance-derived signals stay shadow-only until the legacy stateful plan automaton is validated as an oracle. 'priority' is OPTIONAL (default 0): it only reorders signals that fire at the same hook; with the default, co-firing signals keep spec declaration order, which matches the legacy evaluation sequence. Set it only to deliberately override that order.

advice.template: You seem to navigate between files and code locations in the past {threshold} steps. Options: (1) keep exploring but focus on relevant code only; (2) create and run a reproduction test to better localize the bug; (3) if you already have enough information, edit the source to implement the fix.

You are trying to reproduce the bug in the last {threshold} steps. If you cannot resolve dependencies to create or run reproduction tests within a few attempts, pay more attention to the issue description to locate the bug without reproduction, or start patching if you have localized it.

You have spent the last {threshold} steps editing files to patch the bug. Options: (1) if edits are unsuccessful, reconsider the edit location or string replacements; (2) long sequences of edits can indicate incorrect localization; (3) validate changes step by step rather than batching them.

You have spent the last {threshold} steps validating your changes. Reflect on your code execution rather than writing more tests. If confident the patch is correct, submit it; otherwise revisit the patch.
You have already reviewed this location. If verifying a recent edit, focus on the changed lines; otherwise view a new relevant location or proceed to edit or test.

oscillation._persist_on_block: The escalation counter records warnings already delivered to the agent; a block prevents the action but does not un-tell the agent, so it must survive the rollback. Without this the counter resets on every block and the max_repeats terminal is unreachable, so a stuck agent is blocked forever with no exit ramp (a latent bug shared with the legacy monitor, whose block rollback likewise reverts OscillationDetector.pattern_counts). Persisting makes legacy's own intended warn-N-then-stop-or-submit ladder actually reachable.

advice.template: You are repeating the action {action} with nothing changed since the last time, so its result will be the same. Before running it again, decide what new information or change is actually needed; if nothing would differ, take a different action that moves toward resolving the issue.

variants.multi_node: You are cycling between the actions {actions} (now back to {action}) around steps {steps}, returning to the same states without changing the result. Reason about why you keep revisiting these steps, then take a different action that makes progress on the issue.
variants.max_repeats: You have repeated this loop several times without progress. If you cannot make further progress, stop or submit your patch.

advice.template: You have run the action {action} {threshold}+ times across this trajectory without resolving the issue. Re-running the same step is unlikely to make progress — reason about why it is not working and take a different approach, or stop and submit your current patch.

thought_oscillation._persist_on_block: Same as oscillation: the escalation counter survives a block so the max_repeats terminal is reachable and a repeated-reasoning loop is not blocked forever.

advice.template: You are repeating the same reasoning without producing executable actions. This suggests a format error or circular reasoning. Review the action format requirements and try a different approach.

variants.max_repeats: If you cannot make further progress, stop or submit your patch.

advice.template: Plan compliance violation: you are editing in the {phase} phase before any localization. Explore and localize the bug first, then implement the patch.
Plan compliance violation: you are validating in the {phase} phase before you have patched the code. Implement the fix first, then validate it.
Plan compliance violation: you are about to submit without having patched the code. Implement a fix before submitting.
Plan compliance violation: you are about to submit without validating your changes. Run a test to confirm the fix before submitting.
